title: GraphQL: The Documentary
summary: A documentary on how GraphQL came to be at Facebook, featuring its co-creators Lee Byron, Dan Schafer and Nick Schrock. It covers the problems it solved and its adoption at companies like Twitter, Airbnb and GitHub.
why: HN recommends it for understanding the original motivation behind GraphQL before judging whether it fits your problem.

quote.text: Listen to what the developers tell which problems they had to solve when they invented GraphQL.
